# A spark: a 0.1 m icosahedron, yellow (pool spark) and orange (pool ember), unlit in the bake.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Spark --base-color 0.9255 0.8353 0.4275 --no-slot
material new Ember --base-color 0.9176 0.4667 0.1882 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Spark --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.05 --location 0 0 0
material assign Spark
shade flat
export spark.glb --selection
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ember --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.05 --location 0 0 0
material assign Ember
shade flat
export ember.glb --selection
